page.layout: One column of running text, full measure. No marginal notes. Below the text: signature "A 3" at left and catchword "Tum" at right.

main_text.p: que iudicata, gestaque ad nutum Imperato-ris, qui eidem Concilio tanquam Iudex in-terfuit, & contra innocentes Episcopos, & Legatos Apostolicos multa machinatus est, Latrocinalem Synodum Nicolaus Pontifex congregationem illam appellauit. & apud Græcos, quod in primo congressu de causa Ignatij, in secundo de cultu Imaginum actum est, licet eodem loco eodemque tem-pore, & ab ijsdem celebrata Prima, & Se-cunda sibi nomen vendicauit. Et hæc Con-stantinopoli ante damnationem suam Pho-tius proterue, & maligna mente fingebat, & machinas contra Ignatium admouebat. Sed Romæ in Concilio Apostolicæ Sedis re-stituto Ignatio, Photio, & criminis socijs eie-ctis, depositisque Photius furore concitus, ad-nitentibus Michaële Imperatore & Barda Cæsare Conciliabulum præsidente Imperato-re, nefarijsque hominibus, & Orientalium Sedium Vicarijs suppositis congregat, & in Romanum Pontificem falsa crimina com-miniscēdo anathematis sententiam profert, compositoque libello ea de re, mille circiter subscriptiones Antistitum de suo adumbra-tas inserit, cum præter vnum & viginti, nul-lus prorsus repertus fit tantæ impietatis fau-tor, reclamantibus reliquis, non posse Summ-mum Pontificem ab inferioribus iudicari.

page.notes: Stray ink marks on the page (a small dot after "Ignatij", and spots in the text block and margins) are not printed and are left out. The long s is transcribed as a plain s throughout. Spelling u/v and i/j is normalised as instructed, but "Vicarijs", "vnum" and "Pontifex" are retained as printed. No doubtful readings.
